parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Part one. You hear a conversation about recycling and garbage collection services. First, you have some time to look at questions one to five.

Now listen carefully and answer questions one to five.

Hello. I recently moved into a new house in Avondale, and I'm trying to get a handle on the garbage collection and recycling services. Could you help me with that?

Certainly.

We've recently adjusted our schedule to better meet community needs. While our collection in Avondale used to be on Thursdays, we've shifted to Tuesdays due to popular demand. We recommend setting out your garbage at the designated collection sites the night before to ensure timely pickup.

That's helpful, thanks. What time should I expect the collection truck on that date?

Our trucks are scheduled to arrive and begin collection at eight fifteen AM. This timing helps avoid the rush hour, usually between six thirty AM and seven thirty AM, and ensures that the roads are less congested.

That sounds well-planned. I have an old TV that I need to dispose of. Do you recycle electronics?

Currently, we do not have the facilities to safely recycle electronic appliances like TVs. These items require special handling due to their components and materials.

I recommend checking with local electronic stores or municipal waste facilities. They often offer electronics recycling programs.

Okay, I understand. Do you offer door-to-door garbage collection services?

Unfortunately, due to our current staffing challenges, we cannot provide door-to-door service. However, all major garbage collection sites are clearly marked on the map available on our website. This should help you locate the nearest disposal point conveniently.

Got it. Are there specific preparations we should make with our recycling to assist in the process?

Yes, actually. We highly recommend using the special waste sorting bags that are available for purchase at local grocery stores. These bags are designed to keep different types of recyclable materials separated, which greatly facilitates the recycling process at our facilities.

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions six to ten.

Now listen carefully and answer questions six to ten.

That's a great initiative. What more can families do to improve the recycling process at home?

One of the most effective things families can do is to start by properly sorting their rubbish into categories such as plastics, metals, paper, and organics.

This not only helps in reducing the contamination of recyclables but also improves the efficiency of the recycling process.

That makes sense. For recyclables like cans, bottles, and glass, are there specific preparations we should follow?

Absolutely. Please ensure to remove any labels and rinse the bottles and cans before placing them in the recycling bin. This reduces contamination and the cost of recycling, and it ensures that more materials can be successfully reclaimed and reused.

Should I empty juice bottles that still contain liquids?

Yes, please empty any containers of their contents before disposal. Liquids can damage the recyclable materials and may complicate the recycling process. Ensuring containers are empty also helps in reducing the weight of the recyclables, which lowers transportation costs.

And how should I handle paper products like pizza boxes?

Paper products can often be recycled, but please make sure they are free from food residue. Food contamination can render paper products non-recyclable, as it often leads to mold, which complicates the pulping process. Additionally, regarding egg cartons and similar items, please separate them from other paper recyclables because they are made from different materials that need to be processed separately.

That's very informative. Thank you for all your guidance. I'll definitely follow these instructions to help make the recycling process more effective.

You're very welcome.

That's the end of part one. You now have half a minute to check your answers.

analyses.content: 录音里明确提到，为了满足大家的需求，垃圾收集时间已经从周四改到了星期二（Tuesdays）。
你可能会听到前面的时间“Thursdays”，但一定要注意录音紧接着说了“shifted to（改到了）”，所以要填的是新的时间而不是过去作废的时间。

We've recently adjusted our schedule to better meet community needs. While our collection in Avondale used to be on Thursdays, we've shifted to Tuesdays due to popular demand. We recommend setting out your garbage at the designated collection sites the night before to ensure timely pickup.
针对“卡车几点来”的提问，对方清楚地回答安排在上午八点十五分（eight fifteen AM）到达并开始收集。
你可能会听到后面的“6:30”和“7:30”，但这俩时间只是为了解释8点15分能刚好避开这个时段的早高峰，千万不要把干扰信息当成真正的收集时间。

What time should I expect the collection truck on that date? Our trucks are scheduled to arrive and begin collection at eight fifteen AM. This timing helps avoid the rush hour, usually between six thirty AM and seven thirty AM, and ensures that the roads are less congested.
题干的“不收（will not collect）”对应原文的“没有设施去回收（do not have the facilities to safely recycle）”，而后面跟着的拒收对象“any [ ]”精准对应原文的“electronics / electronic appliances（任何电子产品）”。不能填单数 electronic，不是原词，并且语法也不对。
不能填TV。原文说的是“electronic appliances like TVs”，这里的“like TVs”只是举了个具体例子，机构真正拒收的是前面的“电子产品”；而且题干里有“any”，后面直接填单数“TV”语法根本说不通。

I have an old TV that I need to dispose of. Do you recycle electronics? Currently, we do not have the facilities to safely recycle electronic appliances like TVs. These items require special handling due to their components and materials.
录音中说明，所有主要的垃圾收集点都在网站上提供的地图（map）上有清晰的标记。
你可能会在听到“website（网站）”时就急着写下它，但题干已经给出了“via the internet（通过网络）”，这里需要你填的是网络上具体的指示载体，也就是 map。

Do you offer door-to-door garbage collection services? Unfortunately, due to our current staffing challenges, we cannot provide door-to-door service. However, all major garbage collection sites are clearly marked on the map available on our website. This should help you locate the nearest disposal point conveniently.
工作人员强烈推荐使用可以在当地杂货店（grocery stores）买到的特殊垃圾分类袋。
你可能会在听到“purchase（购买）”时忽略了后面紧跟着的商店类型，做题时一定要留意 stores 前面的核心限定词 grocery。

Are there specific preparations we should make with our recycling to assist in the process? Yes, actually. We highly recommend using the special waste sorting bags that are available for purchase at local grocery stores. These bags are designed to keep different types of recyclable materials separated, which greatly facilitates the recycling process at our facilities.
针对家庭该如何改进回收，最有效的做法就是先把垃圾分门别类，也就是分到不同的类别（categories）中。
你可能会在听到后面具体的塑料、金属（plastics, metals）时慌忙去写具体东西，但题干要求填的是“divide（划分）”的方向，抓住总结性的 categories 才是关键。

What more can families do to improve the recycling process at home? One of the most effective things families can do is to start by properly sorting their rubbish into categories such as plastics, metals, paper, and organics. This not only helps in reducing the contamination of recyclables but also improves the efficiency of the recycling process.
对于瓶瓶罐罐，录音里要求在扔掉前一定要撕掉所有的标签（labels）并冲洗干净。
你可能会因为没听到题目原本的“Remove”，而是听到了换了种说法的“ensure to remove”而没跟上，只要听到跟瓶子相关的处理动作，抓紧后面的核心名词 labels 即可。

For recyclables like cans, bottles, and glass, are there specific preparations we should follow? Absolutely. Please ensure to remove any labels and rinse the bottles and cans before placing them in the recycling bin. This reduces contamination and the cost of recycling, and it ensures that more materials can be successfully reclaimed and reused.
当提问者问到里面还有液体的果汁（juice）瓶子要不要倒空时，工作人员给予了必须倒空的肯定回答。
你可能会因为题目里写的是“empty water”而在录音里死等 water，但提问者一开始就设定了物品是 juice bottles，听到倒空液体时直接联想回去即可。

Should I empty juice bottles that still contain liquids? Yes, please empty any containers of their contents before disposal. Liquids can damage the recyclable materials and may complicate the recycling process.
关于披萨（pizza）盒这类纸制品，工作人员明确提示里面不能留有食物残渣（food residue）。
你可能会先盯着题目里的“food”去定位，但录音是先抛出了目标物品 pizza boxes，随后才交代要清理食物，注意这种说话顺序的颠倒。

And how should I handle paper products like pizza boxes? Paper products can often be recycled, but please make sure they are free from food residue. Food contamination can render paper products non-recyclable, as it often leads to mold, which complicates the pulping process.
对于鸡蛋（egg）纸盒，录音要求必须把它们和其他纸类回收物分开（separate）。
你可能会被句子后半段一大串解释分心，其实在出现“separate（分开）”这个关键动作之前，目标物品 egg 已经被抛出来了，顺着听就很容易抓到。
Additionally, regarding egg cartons and similar items, please separate them from other paper recyclables because they are made from different materials that need to be processed separately.
